1.english_reference: And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁלַ֨ח יְחִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וִֽ יהוּדָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ἑζεκίας ἐπὶ πάντα Ἰσραὴλ καὶ Ἰούδαν ,
traditions.VUL: Misit quoque Ezechías ad omnem Israel et Iudam :
traditions.KJV: And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah ,

1.english_reference: and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh

traditions.WLC: וְ גַֽם אִגְּרוֹת֙ כָּתַב֙ עַל אֶפְרַ֣יִם וּ מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπιστολὰς ἔγραψεν ἐπὶ τὸν Ἐφράιμ καὶ Μανασσὴ
traditions.VUL: scripsítque epístolas ad Ephraim et Manássen ,
traditions.KJV: and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh ,

1.english_reference: that they should come to the house of the LORD at Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: לָ ב֥וֹא לְ בֵית יְהוָ֖ה בִּֽ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ἐλθεῖν εἰς οἶκον Κυρίου εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ
traditions.VUL: ut venírent ad domum Dómini in Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: that they should come to the house of the LORD at Jerusalem ,

1.english_reference: to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel

traditions.WLC: לַ עֲשׂ֣וֹת פֶּ֔סַח לַ יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: ποιῆσαι τὸ φάσεκ τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: et fácerent Phase Dómino Deo Israel .
traditions.KJV: to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel .

2.english_reference: For the king had taken counsel , and his princes , and all the congregation in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּוָּעַ֨ץ הַ מֶּ֧לֶךְ וְ שָׂרָ֛י ו וְ כָל הַ קָּהָ֖ל בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐβουλεύσατο ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες καὶ πᾶσα ἡ ἐκκλησία ἡ ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ
traditions.VUL: Inito ergo consílio regis et príncipum , et univérsi cœtus Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: For the king had taken counsel , and his princes , and all the congregation in Jerusalem ,

2.english_reference: to keep the passover in the second month

traditions.WLC: לַ עֲשׂ֥וֹת הַ פֶּ֖סַח בַּ חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַ שֵּׁנִֽי
traditions.LXX: ποιῆσαι τὸ φάσεκ τῷ μηνὶ τῷ δευτέρῳ .
traditions.VUL: decrevérunt ut fácerent Phase mense secúndo .
traditions.KJV: to keep the passover in the second month .

3.english_reference: For they could not keep it at that time

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י לֹ֧א יָכְל֛וּ לַ עֲשֹׂת֖ וֹ בָּ עֵ֣ת הַ הִ֑יא
traditions.LXX: οὐ γὰρ ἠδυνάσθησαν αὐτὸ ποιῆσαι ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ,
traditions.VUL: Non enim potúerant fácere in témpore suo ,
traditions.KJV: For they could not keep it at that time ,

3.english_reference: because the priests had not sanctified themselves sufficiently

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י הַ כֹּהֲנִים֙ לֹֽא הִתְקַדְּשׁ֣וּ לְ מַ דַּ֔י
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οἱ ἱερεῖς οὐχ ἡγνίσθησαν ἱκανοί ,
traditions.VUL: quia sacerdótes , qui possent suffícere , sanctificáti non fúerant ,
traditions.KJV: because the priests had not sanctified themselves sufficiently ,

3.english_reference: neither had the people gathered themselves together to Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וְ הָ עָ֖ם לֹא נֶאֶסְפ֥וּ לִֽ ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὁ λαὸς οὐ συνήχθη εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ .
traditions.VUL: et pópulus nondum congregátus fúerat in Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: neither had the people gathered themselves together to Jerusalem .

4.english_reference: And the thing pleased the king and all the congregation

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּישַׁ֥ר הַ דָּבָ֖ר בְּ עֵינֵ֣י הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ וּ בְ עֵינֵ֖י כָּל הַ קָּהָֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤρεσεν ὁ λόγος ἐναντίον τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ἐναντίον τῆς ἐκκλησίας .
traditions.VUL: Placuítque sermo regi , et omni multitúdini .
traditions.KJV: And the thing pleased the king and all the congregation .

5.english_reference: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּֽעֲמִ֣ידוּ דָבָ֗ר לְ הַעֲבִ֨יר ק֤וֹל בְּ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔστησαν λόγον διελθεῖν κήρυγμα ἐν παντὶ Ἰσραὴλ
traditions.VUL: Et decrevérunt ut mítterent núntios in univérsum Israel ,
traditions.KJV: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel ,

traditions.WLC: מִ בְּאֵֽר שֶׁ֣בַע וְ עַד דָּ֔ן
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ Βηρσάβεε ἕως Δὰν
traditions.VUL: de Bersabée usque Dan ,
traditions.KJV: from Beersheba even to Dan ,

5.english_reference: that they should come to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel at Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: לָ ב֞וֹא לַ עֲשׂ֥וֹת פֶּ֛סַח לַ יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ἐλθόντες ποιῆσαι τὸ φάσεκ Κυρίῳ θεῷ Ἰσραὴλ ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ ,
traditions.VUL: ut venírent , et fácerent Phase Dómino Deo Israel in Ierúsalem :
traditions.KJV: that they should come to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel at Jerusalem :

5.english_reference: for they had not done [ it ] of a long [ time in such sort ] as it was written

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י לֹ֥א לָ רֹ֛ב עָשׂ֖וּ כַּ כָּתֽוּב
traditions.LXX: ὅτι πλῆθος οὐκ ἐποίησεν κατὰ τὴν γραφήν .
traditions.VUL: multi enim non fécerant sicut lege præscríptum est .
traditions.KJV: for they had not done [ it ] of a long [ time in such sort ] as it was written .

6.english_reference: So the posts went with the letters from the king and his princes

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּלְכוּ֩ הָ רָצִ֨ים בָּֽ אִגְּר֜וֹת מִ יַּ֧ד הַ מֶּ֣לֶךְ וְ שָׂרָ֗י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν οἱ τρέχοντες σὺν ταῖς ἐπιστολαῖς παρὰ τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ τῶν ἀρχόντων
traditions.VUL: Perrexerúntque cursóres cum epístolis ex regis império , et príncipum eius ,
traditions.KJV: So the posts went with the letters from the king and his princes

traditions.WLC: ו בְּ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וִֽ יהוּדָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: εἰς πάντα Ἰσραὴλ καὶ Ἰουδὰ
traditions.VUL: in univérsum Israel et Iudam ,
traditions.KJV: throughout all Israel and Judah ,

6.english_reference: and according to the commandment of the king , saying

traditions.WLC: וּ כְ מִצְוַ֥ת הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ לֵ אמֹ֑ר
traditions.LXX: κατὰ τὸ πρόσταγμα τοῦ βασιλέως λέγοντες
traditions.VUL: iuxta id quod rex iússerat , prædicántes :
traditions.KJV: and according to the commandment of the king , saying ,

6.english_reference: Ye children of Israel , turn again unto the LORD God of Abraham , Isaac , and Israel

traditions.WLC: בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שׁ֚וּבוּ אֶל יְהוָ֗ה אֱלֹהֵי֙ אַבְרָהָם֙ יִצְחָ֣ק וְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.LXX: Οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραήλ , ἐπιστρέψατε πρὸς θεὸν Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: Fílii Israel revertímini ad Dóminum Deum Abraham , et Isaac , et Israel :
traditions.KJV: Ye children of Israel , turn again unto the LORD God of Abraham , Isaac , and Israel ,

6.english_reference: and he will return to the remnant of you , that are escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria

traditions.WLC: וְ יָשֹׁב֙ אֶל הַ פְּלֵיטָ֔ה הַ נִּשְׁאֶ֣רֶת לָ כֶ֔ם מִ כַּ֖ף מַלְכֵ֥י אַשּֽׁוּר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπιστρέψατε τοὺς ἀνασεσωσμένους τοὺς καταλειφθέντας ἀπὸ χειρὸς βασιλέως Ἀσσούρ .
traditions.VUL: et revertétur ad relíquias , quæ effugérunt manum regis Assyriórum .
traditions.KJV: and he will return to the remnant of you , that are escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria .

7.english_reference: And be not ye like your fathers , and like your brethren

traditions.WLC: וְ אַל תִּֽהְי֗וּ כַּ אֲבֽוֹתֵי כֶם֙ וְ כַ֣ אֲחֵי כֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ μὴ γίνεσθε καθὼς οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ὑμῶν
traditions.VUL: Nolíte fíeri sicut patres vestri et fratres ,
traditions.KJV: And be not ye like your fathers , and like your brethren ,

7.english_reference: which trespassed against the LORD God of their fathers

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָעֲל֔וּ בַּ יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתֵי הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: οἳ ἀπέστησαν ἀπὸ Κυρίου θεοῦ πατέρων αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: qui recessérunt a Dómino Deo patrum suórum ,
traditions.KJV: which trespassed against the LORD God of their fathers , [ who ]

7.english_reference: [ who ] therefore gave them up to desolation , as ye see

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתְּנֵ֣ ם לְ שַׁמָּ֔ה כַּ אֲשֶׁ֖ר אַתֶּ֥ם רֹאִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς εἰς ἐρήμωσιν καθὼς ὑμεῖς ὁρᾶτε .
traditions.VUL: qui trádidit eos in intéritum , ut ipsi cérnitis .
traditions.KJV: therefore gave them up to desolation , as ye see .

8.english_reference: Now be ye not stiffnecked , as your fathers [ were ]

traditions.WLC: עַתָּ֕ה אַל תַּקְשׁ֥וּ עָרְפְּ כֶ֖ם כַּ אֲבוֹתֵי כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν μὴ σκληρύνητε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν ·
traditions.VUL: Nolíte induráre cervíces vestras , sicut patres vestri :
traditions.KJV: Now be ye not stiffnecked , as your fathers [ were , but ]

traditions.WLC: תְּנוּ יָ֣ד לַ יהוָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: δότε δόξαν Κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ ,
traditions.VUL: trádite manus Dómino ,
traditions.KJV: yield yourselves unto the LORD ,

8.english_reference: and enter into his sanctuary , which he hath sanctified for ever

traditions.WLC: וּ בֹ֤אוּ לְ מִקְדָּשׁ וֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְדִּ֣ישׁ לְ עוֹלָ֔ם
traditions.LXX: εἰσέλθατε εἰς τὸ ἁγίασμα αὐτοῦ ὅ ἡγίασεν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ,
traditions.VUL: et veníte ad sanctuárium eius , quod sanctificávit in ætérnum :
traditions.KJV: and enter into his sanctuary , which he hath sanctified for ever :

8.english_reference: and serve the LORD your God

traditions.WLC: וְ עִבְדוּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי כֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ δουλεύσατε τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: servíte Dómino Deo patrum vestrórum ,
traditions.KJV: and serve the LORD your God ,

8.english_reference: that the fierceness of his wrath may turn away from you

traditions.WLC: וְ יָשֹׁ֥ב מִ כֶּ֖ם חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ἀποστρέψει ἀφ᾽ ὑμῶν θυμὸν ὀργῆς .
traditions.VUL: et avertétur a vobis ira furóris eius .
traditions.KJV: that the fierceness of his wrath may turn away from you .

9.english_reference: For if ye turn again unto the LORD

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י בְ שׁוּבְ כֶ֞ם עַל יְהוָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐν τῷ ἐπιστρέφειν ὑμᾶς πρὸς Κύριον
traditions.VUL: Si enim vos revérsi fuéritis ad Dóminum :
traditions.KJV: For if ye turn again unto the LORD ,

9.english_reference: your brethren and your children [ shall find ] compassion before them that lead them captive

traditions.WLC: אֲחֵי כֶ֨ם וּ בְנֵי כֶ֤ם לְ רַחֲמִים֙ לִ פְנֵ֣י שֽׁוֹבֵי הֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν ἔσονται ἐν οἰκτειρμοῖς ἀντὶ πάντων αἰχμαλωτισάντων αὐτούς ,
traditions.VUL: fratres vestri , et fílii habébunt misericórdiam coram dóminis suis , qui illos duxérunt captívos ,
traditions.KJV: your brethren and your children [ shall find ] compassion before them that lead them captive ,

9.english_reference: so that they shall come again into this land

traditions.WLC: וְ לָ שׁ֖וּב לָ אָ֣רֶץ הַ זֹּ֑את
traditions.LXX: ἀποστρέψει εἰς τὴν γῆν ταύτην ·
traditions.VUL: et reverténtur in terram hanc :
traditions.KJV: so that they shall come again into this land :

9.english_reference: for the LORD your God [ is ] gracious and merciful

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי חַנּ֤וּן וְ רַחוּם֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי כֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐλεήμων καὶ οἰκτείρμων Κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: pius enim et clemens est Dóminus Deus vester ,
traditions.KJV: for the LORD your God [ is ] gracious and merciful ,

9.english_reference: and will not turn away [ his ] face from you , if ye return unto him

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹא יָסִ֤יר פָּנִים֙ מִ כֶּ֔ם אִם תָּשׁ֖וּבוּ אֵלָֽי ו
traditions.LXX: οὐκ ἀποστρέψει τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἀφ᾽ ὑμῶν , ἐὰν ἐπιστρέψωμεν πρὸς αὐτόν .
traditions.VUL: et non avértet fáciem suam a vobis , si revérsi fuéritis ad eum .
traditions.KJV: and will not turn away [ his ] face from you , if ye return unto him .

10.english_reference: So the posts passed from city to city

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּֽהְי֨וּ הָ רָצִ֜ים עֹבְרִ֨ים מֵ עִ֧יר לָ עִ֛יר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦσαν οἱ τρέχοντες διαπορευόμενοι πόλιν ἐκ πόλεως
traditions.VUL: Igitur cursóres pergébant velóciter de civitáte in civitátem ,
traditions.KJV: So the posts passed from city to city

10.english_reference: through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh even unto Zebulun

traditions.WLC: בְּ אֶֽרֶץ אֶפְרַ֥יִם וּ מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וְ עַד זְבֻל֑וּן
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῷ ὄρει Ἐφράιμ καὶ Μανασσὴ καὶ ἕως Ζαβουλών ·
traditions.VUL: per terram Ephraim et Manásse usque ad Zábulon ,
traditions.KJV: through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh even unto Zebulun :

10.english_reference: but they laughed them to scorn , and mocked them

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּֽהְיוּ֙ מַשְׂחִיקִ֣ים עֲלֵי הֶ֔ם וּ מַלְעִגִ֖ים בָּֽ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένοντο ὡς καταγελῶντες αὐτῶν καὶ καταμωκώμενοι .
traditions.VUL: illis irridéntibus et subsannántibus eos .
traditions.KJV: but they laughed them to scorn , and mocked them .

11.english_reference: Nevertheless divers of Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled themselves

traditions.WLC: אַךְ אֲנָשִׁ֛ים מֵ אָשֵׁ֥ר וּ מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וּ מִ זְּבֻל֑וּן נִֽכְנְע֔וּ
traditions.LXX: ἀλλὰ ἄνθρωποι Ἀσὴρ καὶ ἀπὸ Μανασσὴ καὶ ἀπὸ Ζαβουλὼν ἐτράπησαν ,
traditions.VUL: Attamen quidam viri ex Aser , et Manásse , et Zábulon acquiescéntes consílio ,
traditions.KJV: Nevertheless divers of Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled themselves ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֖אוּ לִ ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ
traditions.VUL: venérunt Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: and came to Jerusalem .

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν Ἰούδᾳ .

12.english_reference: Also in Judah the hand of God was to give them one heart

traditions.WLC: גַּ֣ם בִּ יהוּדָ֗ה הָֽיְתָה֙ יַ֣ד הָ אֱלֹהִ֔ים לָ תֵ֥ת לָ הֶ֖ם לֵ֣ב אֶחָ֑ד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο χεὶρ Κυρίου δοῦναι αὐτοῖς καρδίαν μίαν
traditions.VUL: In Iuda vero facta est manus Dómini ut daret eis cor unum ,
traditions.KJV: Also in Judah the hand of God was to give them one heart

12.english_reference: to do the commandment of the king and of the princes , by the word of the LORD

traditions.WLC: לַ עֲשׂ֞וֹת מִצְוַ֥ת הַ מֶּ֛לֶךְ וְ הַ שָּׂרִ֖ים בִּ דְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: ἐλθεῖν τοῦ ποιῆσαι κατὰ τὰ προστάγματα τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ τῶν ἀρχόντων ἐν λόγῳ Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: ut fácerent iuxta præcéptum regis , et príncipum verbum Dómini .
traditions.KJV: to do the commandment of the king and of the princes , by the word of the LORD .

13.english_reference: And there assembled at Jerusalem much people

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּֽאָסְפ֤וּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ עַם רָ֔ב
traditions.LXX: καὶ συνήχθησαν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ λαὸς πολὺς
traditions.VUL: Congregatíque sunt in Ierúsalem pópuli multi ,
traditions.KJV: And there assembled at Jerusalem much people

13.english_reference: to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month

traditions.WLC: לַ עֲשׂ֛וֹת אֶת חַ֥ג הַ מַּצּ֖וֹת בַּ חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ שֵּׁנִ֑י
traditions.LXX: τοῦ ποιῆσαι τὴν ἑορτὴν τῶν ἀζύμων ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ δευτέρῳ ,
traditions.VUL: ut fácerent solemnitátem azymórum , in mense secúndo :
traditions.KJV: to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁחֲט֣וּ הַ פֶּ֔סַח בְּ אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר לַ חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ שֵּׁנִ֑י

traditions.VUL: Immolavérunt autem Phase quartadécima die mensis secúndi .
traditions.KJV: Then they killed the passover on the fourteenth [ day ] of the second month :

15.english_reference: and the priests and the Levites were ashamed , and sanctified themselves

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ כֹּהֲנִ֨ים וְ הַ לְוִיִּ֤ם נִכְלְמוּ֙ וַ יִּֽתְקַדְּשׁ֔וּ

traditions.KJV: And they stood in their place after their manner ,

traditions.WLC: כְּ תוֹרַ֖ת מֹשֶׁ֣ה אִישׁ הָ אֱלֹהִ֑ים

traditions.KJV: according to the law of Moses the man of God :

traditions.WLC: הַ כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ זֹרְקִ֣ים אֶת הַ דָּ֔ם מִ יַּ֖ד הַ לְוִיִּֽם

traditions.WLC: כִּי רַבַּ֥ת בַּ קָּהָ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא הִתְקַדָּ֑שׁוּ

traditions.KJV: For [ there were ] many in the congregation that were not sanctified :

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ לְוִיִּ֞ם עַל שְׁחִיטַ֣ת הַ פְּסָחִ֗ים לְ כֹל֙ לֹ֣א טָה֔וֹר לְ הַקְדִּ֖ישׁ לַ יהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται ἦσαν τοῦ θύειν τὸ φάσεκ παντὶ τῷ μὴ δυναμένῳ ἁγνισθῆναι τῷ κυρίῳ .
traditions.VUL: et idcírco immolárent Levítæ Phase his qui non occúrrerant sanctificári Dómino .
traditions.KJV: therefore the Levites had the charge of the killing of the passovers for every one [ that was ] not clean , to sanctify [ them ] unto the LORD .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י מַרְבִּ֣ית הָ עָ֡ם רַ֠בַּת מֵֽ אֶפְרַ֨יִם וּ מְנַשֶּׁ֜ה יִשָּׂשכָ֤ר וּ זְבֻלוּן֙ לֹ֣א הִטֶּהָ֔רוּ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι πλεῖστον τοῦ λαοῦ ἀπὸ Ἐφράιμ καὶ Μανασσὴ καὶ Ἰσσαχάρ , Ζαβουλών , οὐχ ἥγνισαν ,

traditions.KJV: For a multitude of the people , [ even ] many of Ephraim , and Manasseh , Issachar , and Zebulun , had not cleansed themselves ,

18.english_reference: yet did they eat the passover otherwise than it was written

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי אָכְל֥וּ אֶת הַ פֶּ֖סַח בְּ לֹ֣א כַ כָּת֑וּב

traditions.WLC: כִּי֩ הִתְפַּלֵּ֨ל יְחִזְקִיָּ֤הוּ עֲלֵי הֶם֙ לֵ אמֹ֔ר יְהוָ֥ה הַ טּ֖וֹב יְכַפֵּ֥ר בְּעַֽד
traditions.LXX: καὶ προσηύξατο Ἑζεκίας περὶ αὐτῶν λέγων Κύριος ἀγαθὸς ἐξιλάσθω .

traditions.KJV: But Hezekiah prayed for them , saying , The good LORD pardon every one

19.english_reference: [ That ] prepareth his heart to seek God , the LORD God of his fathers

traditions.WLC: כָּל לְבָב֣ וֹ הֵכִ֔ין לִ דְר֛וֹשׁ הָ אֱלֹהִ֥ים יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתָ֑י
traditions.LXX: ὑπὲρ πάσης καρδίας κατευθυνούσης ἐκζητησούσης Κύριον τὸν θεὸν τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν ,

traditions.KJV: [ That ] prepareth his heart to seek God , the LORD God of his fathers ,

traditions.WLC: ו וְ לֹ֖א כְּ טָהֳרַ֥ת הַ קֹּֽדֶשׁ

traditions.VUL: et non imputábit eis quod minus sanctificáti sunt .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ אֶל יְחִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ

traditions.KJV: And the LORD hearkened to Hezekiah ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּרְפָּ֖א אֶת הָ עָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἰάσατο τὸν λαόν .
traditions.VUL: et placátus est pópulo .
traditions.KJV: and healed the people .

traditions.WLC: שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים בְּ שִׂמְחָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה

traditions.VUL: septem diébus in lætítia magna ,

traditions.KJV: with loud instruments unto the LORD .

traditions.KJV: and making confession to the LORD God of their fathers .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּוָּֽעֲצוּ֙ כָּל הַ קָּהָ֔ל לַ עֲשׂ֕וֹת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים

traditions.KJV: And the whole assembly took counsel to keep other seven days :

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּֽעֲשׂ֥וּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִ֖ים שִׂמְחָֽה

24.english_reference: For Hezekiah king of Judah did give to the congregation a thousand bullocks and seven thousand sheep

24.english_reference: and the princes gave to the congregation a thousand bullocks and ten thousand sheep

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ שָּׂרִ֞ים הֵרִ֤ימוּ לַ קָּהָל֙ פָּרִ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וְ צֹ֖אן עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֑ים

24.english_reference: and a great number of priests sanctified themselves

traditions.VUL: sanctificáta est ergo sacerdótum plúrima multitúdo .
traditions.KJV: and a great number of priests sanctified themselves .

25.english_reference: And all the congregation of Judah , with the priests and the Levites , and all the congregation that came out of Israel , and the strangers that came out of the land of Israel , and that dwelt in Judah

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּשְׂמְח֣וּ כָּל קְהַ֣ל יְהוּדָ֗ה וְ הַ כֹּהֲנִים֙ וְ הַ לְוִיִּ֔ם וְ כָל הַ קָּהָ֖ל הַ בָּאִ֣ים מִ יִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ הַ גֵּרִ֗ים הַ בָּאִים֙ מֵ אֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ הַ יּוֹשְׁבִ֖ים בִּ יהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ηὐθράνθη πᾶσα ἡ ἐκκλησία , οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται , καὶ πᾶσα ἡ ἐκκλησία Ἰούδα , καὶ οἱ εὑρεθέντες ἐξ Ἰσραήλ , καὶ οἱ προσήλυτοι οἱ εἰσελθόντες ἀπὸ γῆς Ἰσραὴλ καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἀπὸ Ἰούδα .
traditions.VUL: Et hilaritáte perfúsa omnis turba Iuda , tam sacerdótum et Levitárum , quam univérsæ frequéntiæ , quæ vénerat ex Israel : proselytórum quoque de terra Israel , et habitántium in Iuda .
traditions.KJV: And all the congregation of Judah , with the priests and the Levites , and all the congregation that came out of Israel , and the strangers that came out of the land of Israel , and that dwelt in Judah ,
rejoiced .

26.english_reference: So there was great joy in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וַ תְּהִ֥י שִׂמְחָֽה גְדוֹלָ֖ה בִּֽ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο εὐφροσύνη μεγάλη ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ ·
traditions.VUL: Factáque est grandis celébritas in Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: So there was great joy in Jerusalem :

26.english_reference: for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel [ there was ] not the like in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: כִּ֠י מִ ימֵ֞י שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה בֶן דָּוִיד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א כָ זֹ֖את בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָֽם

traditions.VUL: qualis a diébus Salomónis fílii David regis Israel in ea urbe non fúerat .
traditions.KJV: for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel [ there was ] not the like in Jerusalem .

27.english_reference: Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people

traditions.VUL: Surrexérunt autem sacerdótes atque Levítæ benedicéntes pópulo :
traditions.KJV: Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people :
